feature: Local-first quest completion and optimistic claims
scope: Mobile client only; no production migrations or API deployment
behavior: Durable, user/day/pair-scoped completion facts project daily task readiness immediately
Daily and special claims persist before optimistic coins are presented
Wire claims wait for valid completion receipts; special milestone claims settle in stage order
Unknown network failures retain intents, predicted balances and stable retry IDs
Definitive rejection corrects shared claimed/progress state and predicted coins
Stale bootstrap reads cannot erase local task facts or replay reward animations
Raw personal bootstrap caches exclude projected completion and claim data
Photo-less plushies do not qualify; rejected photo uploads invalidate their speculative completion
Game eligibility remains both players completing a round; old history cannot complete today's task
Saved journal text alone does not prove supplementary quest registration; a receipt or authoritative refresh releases Claim
Toy delivery uses bounded exponential retry without changing non-sliding hourly Moments aggregation
